---- MODULE Case ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC
(* --algorithm A { variable x=0; {L:with (a=1, b \in {2,3}) { x:=a+b; }; B:skip; }} *)
====
generated_body:
VARIABLES pc, x

vars == << pc, x >>

Init == (* Global variables *)
        /\ x = 0
        /\ pc = "L"

L == /\ pc = "L"
     /\ LET a == 1 IN
          \E b \in {2,3}:
            x' = a+b
     /\ pc' = "B"

B == /\ pc = "B"
     /\ TRUE
     /\ pc' = "Done"
     /\ x' = x

(* Allow infinite stuttering to prevent deadlock on termination. *)
Terminating == pc = "Done" /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == L \/ B
           \/ Terminating

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Termination == <>(pc = "Done")
